_comment: Official source register for decision_lab/. Every row published by this directory cites one of
these source IDs. A source may only be entered here if the page was opened and read during this
session (2026-11-12 UTC) by session arena/e35b6c85-korea3, OR if the fetch failed, in which case
"read" is false and every value that depends on it is left blank and flagged.
official-league    - published by the NFL (nfl.com, operations.nfl.com, support.nfl.com,
static.www.nfl.com). Primary authority for league facts.
official-club      - published by an NFL member club. Cited only where NFL.com itself links it.
third-party        - NOT an official publisher. Listed only to record that it was found and
rejected as evidence. Never used to fill a value.
NO betting price, odds line, correlation coefficient, ROI figure or strategy result appears in this
register, because no official publisher publishes one for this project.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: Per-player weekly injury report rows for Week 10 of the 2026 season: player name, position code, injury text, practice status and game status, each linked to that player's official NFL.com page. Also the official Week 10 game list with kickoff time, broadcast and each club's win-loss-tie record, and the official NFL.com news headlines listed on the same page.

sources.title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: Confirms that the unqualified /injuries/ path resolves to the current week, which at capture time is Week 10 of the 2026 season, and that the week selector offers WEEK 1 through WEEK 10 for season 2026 and seasons back to 1965. Establishes that the report is the current-week snapshot, not an archive.

sources.title: NFL news roundup: Browns to start QB Deshaun Watson vs. Texans; Cardinals' Carson Beck to start vs. Rams | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com
sources.read_note: Read in full for the Arizona, Atlanta, Baltimore, Buffalo, Carolina, Cincinnati, Cleveland and Dallas club sections. The remaining club sections are in later page chunks that this session could not retrieve; values for those clubs are therefore not published from this source.
sources.supports: Official DEPTH CHART NEWS entries naming the starting quarterback and the player he replaces (Carson Beck for Arizona, first career start; Deshaun Watson for Cleveland, with Shedeur Sanders having started Week 9), plus per-player injury type, practice status, injured-reserve designations to return, activations off injured reserve, practice-squad signings and roster cuts.

sources.title: Kansas City Chiefs 2026 Player Roster | NFL.com
sources.supports: Official club roster page structure: rows are ordered alphabetically by player surname and carry player name, jersey number, position code, a roster STATUS code (observed value: ACT), height, weight, years of experience and college. The page's club navigation offers exactly three tabs: Info, Roster, Stats. There is NO depth-chart tab and NO first/second/third-string ordering anywhere on the page. Page header also carries the club's record and division place (Kansas City Chiefs, 2nd AFC West, 6-2-0).

sources.title: 2025 NFL Division Standings
sources.supports: Final 2025 regular-season division standings for all 32 clubs, with wins, losses, ties, win percentage, points for, points against, point differential, division, conference and home/road records, and streak. Used only to confirm that completed-season aggregates remain retrievable by season, which the live 2026 season does not yet permit.
